xmldoc.short_description: Read protobuf bytes without a schema.

param_input_item.param_description: logical (default false): read the bytes as a length-delimited stream.

param_output_item.param_description: the fields read without a schema, as protoc --decode_raw prints them. With no output, the text is displayed.

a struct array with Number, Wire ('varint', 'fixed64', 'bytes', 'group' or 'fixed32'), Value, Text and Fields (the fields of a nested message, or []); a cell with one struct array per record with 'Delimited'.

description.p: protobuf.inspect reads the field numbers, wire types and values of protobuf bytes without a schema, the way protoc --decode_raw does. It helps when the schema is unknown or when a byte stream must be examined, and it returns the parsed fields as a struct for further use.
